method.pricegunDateBuckets: 2026-11-12 through 2026-11-26 UTC; endpoint days may be partial
method.resaleReference: floor(min(Pricegun time-weighted value, median of returned recent transaction unit prices)); null without window sales
method.modeledCost: floor(base * 0.85) for jelly plus one eligible 5% pants discount; floor(base * 0.95) for pants alone; no Five Finger Discount; confirm actual charge
notes: Catalog contains closed/path/outfit-gated offers; lowest modeled offer is not asserted accessible.
Recorded units are observed Pricegun sales, not seller demand or guaranteed market share.
Excluded shared mallprices cache from resale reference because it can include NPC prices and is not a live mall-only offer.
No account login, purchases, item use or listings were performed.
One jelly per intended single-item purchase batch; batch costs and spleen displacement are not included in per-unit spread.
method.medianDefinition: Arithmetic mean of the two central prices for an even number of returned transactions; unit prices are not quantity weighted.
